description: This file implements a workaround for the texelFetchOffset translation issue in shader compilation, traversing and modifying the abstract syntax tree to replace texelFetchOffset calls with texelFetch calls, specifically for GLSL shader versions 3.0 and above.

classes.name: Traverser
classes.description: A class that traverses the shader's intermediate representation to find and replace texelFetchOffset calls.

methods.name: Apply
methods.description: Static method to apply the traversal and perform replacements if necessary.

methods.name: visitAggregate
methods.description: Visits aggregate nodes in the AST to identify texelFetchOffset calls.

methods.name: nextIteration
methods.description: Prepares for the next traversal iteration.
